rationale: The bid-ask spread of 322 bps is prohibitively wide for intraday trading — any position would start with an immediate ~1.6% adverse cost just to enter and exit, far exceeding the ATR-based move potential. Volume is extremely thin at only 15,920 shares with relative volume below 1x, making execution and exit highly uncertain. Despite the positive earnings news, the structural liquidity conditions make a risk-controlled intraday trade unviable in either direction.
